note: Single wooded loop; Lake Wooldridge is a quarter-mile hike below. No dump station on site; the nearest is in Marshall. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2026/2027 rate sheets ($14-15 basic, electric to $29), 50A electric-only and basic sites, 21 reservable sites to 60 ft, showers/vault toilets, no dump, reservations Apr 15-Oct 31 with walk-ups otherwise; pin is 1.1 km off the loop.
